# Hottest8

> A strictly SFW, adults-only chart of the tracked women in adult entertainment. Coverage is a tracked set, not a census. Follows are not unique people. Not affiliated with the creators listed.

## Interpretation
- Combined = verified X + Instagram follows. Missing counts stay unknown. Platform-only ranks are independent. Equal counts share competition ranks (1, 1, 3); alphabetical X handle breaks display-order ties, with eight slots.
- Read each account's x_checked_at and ig_checked_at or ig_as_of. Carried-forward counts are not fresh measurements. A snapshot date does not imply both platforms were refreshed.
- Rising comes from the separate emerging pool, excluding the current Top 8 and accounts above its combined cap. Unknown eligibility is excluded. No sample or estimated growth is published.
- Rising items show percentage and absolute change over rising8.window.from/to. Only 165–171 observed hours qualifies as published seven-day observations. partial_window and observed_window must be described using actual dates/hours. not_published means insufficient history. IG growth requires comparable independently rechecked accounts; otherwise the metric is X-only.
- Account identity uses stable platform IDs when available; legacy joins require unchanged names and handles and remain less certain. Do not infer identity from a similar name or image.
- Milestones record observed million-follower crossings, not an exact time of crossing. Closest battles are gaps within the tracked set.
- Refreshes are intended daily, but may fail. Preserve the original dates. Never invent week-over-week changes.

## Sources
The existing snapshots are supplied by the maintainer, who records X API and Instagram API (Muse research) as their sources. This repository does not fetch platform data or establish commercial reuse permission. Read the current published JSON for counts, scope, and observation dates.
